fair_value.own_history: median P/E of the stock's previous 36-60 month-end observations (from 2012-01-01), gap = median / current P/E - 1
fair_value.sector: median current P/E of sector peers with positive earnings (>= 4), else the universe median (>= 9); gap = median / current P/E - 1

protocol.solid_company: profitability and financial-health scores >= 50 and positive TTM earnings
protocol.trade: LONG if gap >= +20%, SHORT if gap <= -20%; timed variants only when the technical component has the same sign
protocol.unit: calendar month of the decision (2016-01 onward)
protocol.interval: Newey-West lag ceil(window/21) on monthly means; t(n-1) at a two-sided 99.5% quantile (Bonferroni over the five hypotheses)

hypotheses.H9: own-history fair value, solid companies, timed, 120 sessions beats abstention (primary)
hypotheses.H12: sector fair value, solid companies, timed, 120 sessions
hypotheses.H13: timing adds value: H9 policy minus H10 policy

protocol.coverage: at least 24 active months, else INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE
protocol.holdout: decisions after 2026-08 form a confirmatory forward sample; this run uses 2016-01..2026-08
protocol.use: baseline for the forward direction test; never changes trading, the live protocol or promotion
caveats: Universe is today's coverage list: survivorship-biased.
Fundamental scoring thresholds were hand-set in 2026 with knowledge of these histories.
No historical headlines: the news component is missing throughout.
The replay composite has no earnings-surprise (expectations) input.
Short positions carry no borrow cost; fills are at closes with fixed costs.
P/E fair values ignore growth differences; sector labels are today's.
Monthly decisions with 60/120-session windows overlap; the HAC lag accounts for it.
